reading.verdict: four-factor net alpha, named only where the exit session included and excluded agree; an agreement test, neither side is a bound
reading.independence: the pool re-selects over the symbols whose walk-forwards are listed beside it; these are one body of evidence, not independent tests, and no multiplicity adjustment is applied
reading.sensitivity: four_factor_net_exposure_weighted weights each trade by 1/(L^2 h); it is reported, not the verdict
